overview_description.description: Axle Health provides scheduling and workforce management software for home health care providers. The Axle platform includes a mobile app for clinicians, an operations dashboard for office teams, proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, and a patient engagement and booking solution. Axle is integrated with a wide range of EMRs, and the entire Axle product can be customized and accessed modularly via API. Some of the biggest home health care providers in the country use Axle’s software to improve the utilization of their clinical teams, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

about_short_description.short_description: Scheduling and workforce management software for home health care providers

product.name: AI Scheduling
product.description: Automates scheduling by matching patients with the optimal clinician and adapting to changes in real time, reducing manual scheduling work.

product.name: Route Optimization
product.description: Generates efficient travel routes for clinicians to reduce drive time and missed visits using proprietary logistics algorithms.

product.name: Automated Patient Engagement
product.description: Sends automated reminders, live ETAs, and collects patient feedback via SMS or phone calls to reduce missed visits and improve communication.

product.name: Real-Time Workforce Visibility
product.description: Provides live tracking of clinician location, schedule adherence, and route progress to identify coverage gaps and improve operational oversight.

product.name: Seamless Integration and API
product.description: Connects Axle Health’s platform with EMRs, CRMs, HR systems, and other software via pre-built integrations and flexible APIs for data synchronization.
